analysis.purpose: Segments the soul into architecturally meaningful modules — workspace packages when known, otherwise directory prefixes — and attaches per-module counts, stereotypes, top symbols and a purpose resolved bottom-up from the semantic layer.
responsibilities: Group symbols into modules by workspace package or directory prefix
Rank each module top symbols by importance, deprioritizing tests
Resolve a module purpose from the semantic overlay when one exists
Stay deterministic: every iteration is id-sorted

businessRules.rule: Modules are computed on demand rather than stored as a node kind, because NodeKind is a closed enum.
businessRules.rationale: Avoids a schema bump for a purely derived grouping.

businessRules.rule: Two runs over the same soul produce byte-identical output.
businessRules.rationale: Determinism keeps the overview diffable and cacheable.

nodes.name: Module segmentation
nodes.summary: Derived architectural modules with ranked symbols.

edges.rationale: This file builds the functional map.

evidence.why: Modules are a derived TypeScript shape, not a soul NodeKind.
The map is computed on demand and returned as a plain structure.
